notes: Very clean course: ~81% of flags are false positives (85 fp_subgloss + 22 fp_inflection) — overwhelmingly Portuguese tokens sliced as 'component' inside larger LEGOs (negation pieces of 'não', the 'muito/que/de/a' function words, verb infinitive↔gerund↔bare forms) and never drilled bare. The real fixes (24 consolidate/differentiate + 1 data error) cluster in two patterns: (a) full sentence build/use pairs that differ only by a dangling 'to'/'it'/'you'/'it is' — easy re-gloss consolidations, mostly low severity; and (b) the intentional SSi do-support statement↔question convergence ('falas inglês' etc.) and genuine PT pronoun ambiguity ('o' = you-formal/him, subjunctive 'precise' = I/you) flagged as real_differentiate — confirm the do-support cases are the designed pattern before splitting. No high-frequency single drilled token is overloaded, so zero release blockers.
